interface.engine_side: 13 per-bank MM2S and S2MM adapter control and 64-bit AXI stream arrays from common datamover_engine
interface.bank_side: role 1 write and role 2 read ports of smollm2_bank_subsystem
interface.shared_dependency_change: s2mm_adapter.bank_read_issue exposes one actual native read request; bank_enb also covers pipeline hold cycles

control_rules.grant: Granted only when requested bank is legal, acquired by the dispatcher, and owned by DMA role 1 or 2
control_rules.load: MM2S adapter converts two 64-bit stream beats to each 128-bit bank word; a one-cycle 165-bit role-1 write register sustains one word per cycle, and LOAD done waits until its final registered write is accepted by the bank router
control_rules.store: S2MM adapter issues only actual read requests; a one-cycle registered role-2 request plus the bank's three-cycle response yields four cycles to the adapter before conversion to 64-bit stream beats
control_rules.fault: Rejected access, missing or mismatched three-cycle STORE read response, illegal or unowned grant request, or simultaneous same-direction local access sets sticky bridge_fault and direction flags until reset; smollm2_dma_engine_link converts them to corresponding command failure and engine abort
control_rules.success: Adapter done alone is not DDR completion; the common DataMover engine must also accept a successful matching status before dispatcher completion

required_cases: model-legal DMA_LOAD into B0 with registered write drained before done, then compute-role read
compute-role write into B5 then DMA_STORE stream
common adapter regression after read-issue port addition
required_tools: self-checking XSIM with XPM bank subsystem
verification.proof_scope: stream adapter to local bank connection only; no vendor DataMover IP, DDR response, board placement or Vitis execution
